## Why This Is Asked

Tests end-to-end collaboration under real-world network conditions and multi-tenant data isolation, ensuring eventual consistency and auditable operations.

## Key Concepts

- Real-time collaboration algorithms (CRDT/OT) and convergence
- Offline/online transitions and reconciliation
- Tenant data isolation and access controls
- End-to-end auditing of edits
- Network partition simulation and latency modeling

## Code Example

```javascript
// Playwright test scaffold for two users editing the same doc
async function testCollaborativeEdit(page1, page2, docId) {
  await page1.goto(`/docs/${docId}`)
  await page2.goto(`/docs/${docId}`)
  // simulate offline on page2, then edit on both, reconnect, verify
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you scale this to 3+ concurrent editors across regions?
- How would you verify performance under burst edits and ensure audit log integrity?

questions.explanation:
## Architecture
- **Contract Testing**: Leverage Pact for API contract validation between services
- **Component Testing**: Validate individual service functionality using test containers
- **Journey Testing**: Execute end-to-end tests for critical user paths across multiple services

## Isolation Strategy
- **Test Containers**: Deploy dependencies in isolated Docker containers
- **Mock Services**: Replace external dependencies with WireMock for consistent testing
- **Data Management**: Implement deterministic test data with automated cleanup hooks

## Parallel Execution
- **Kubernetes**: Execute tests in parallel pods with defined resource constraints
- **Test Sharding**: Distribute test suites by service or functionality for optimal performance
